en.t: Empress Mother Fujitsubo also came into the palace.

units.source_text: 她酷爱绘画，惟此难于舍弃，诵经礼佛也懈怠了。

en.t: She loved painting passionately, and because this alone was hard for her to give up, she even grew lax in chanting sutras and worshiping the Buddha.

units.source_text: 她看见众宫女各抒论见，便把她们分为左右两方：

en.t: Seeing the ladies of the court each express their own views, she divided them into left and right sides:

units.source_text: 梅壶女御的左方，有平典侍、侍从内侍、少将命妇等人；

en.t: On the left side, supporting the Kokiden consort of the Plum Pavilion, were Taira no Naishi no Suke, Jiju no Naishi, Shosho no Myobu, and others;

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御的右方，有大弍典侍、中将命妇、后卫命妇等人。

en.t: On the right side, supporting the Kokiden consort, were Daini no Naishi no Suke, Chujo no Myobu, Goe no Myobu, and others.

units.source_text: 这些人都是当今有名的女鉴识家。

en.t: All of these women were renowned female connoisseurs of the day.

units.source_text: 她们互相争论，各有理由，藤壶母后听了颇感兴趣。

en.t: They argued with one another, each side having its reasons, and Empress Mother Fujitsubo listened with considerable interest.

units.source_text: 先将左方所出品的物语鼻祖《竹取物语》中的老翁和右方所出品的《空穗物语》中的俊荫这两卷画并列起来，

en.t: First, they should place side by side the left side's scroll of the old bamboo cutter from The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, regarded as the ancestor of tales, and the right side's scroll of Toshikage from The Tale of the Hollow Tree,
and have the two sides debate their relative merits.
